assertions.text: Output has exactly one line per input bullet (6 lines), each matching '- [<TYPE>] <Summary> (#<id>)'
TYPE values are mapped correctly: feature to FEAT, bug to FIX, docs to DOCS, refactor to CHORE
Lines are grouped in the order FEAT, FIX, DOCS, CHORE
Input order is kept inside a group (#7 before #9 under FEAT, #12 before #14 under FIX)
Each summary is sentence case, has no trailing period and is at most 60 characters
